claims.text: Orville and Wilbur Wright made powered aeroplane flights near Kitty Hawk, North Carolina, in December 1903.
The Montgolfier brothers flew hot-air balloons in 1783, the Lumière brothers were film pioneers, and the Lilienthal brothers built gliders; none of them made the 1903 Kitty Hawk flights.
The Wright brothers' first flight, on 17 December 1903, lasted about 12 seconds and covered about 37 m (120 feet).
A Boeing 747's wingspan is about 60 m or more, longer than 37 m.
